selected.title: MCP reference servers v1.0.0: evaluate a stable reference package without mistaking it for production software
selected.summary: The MCP steering group's reference repository published v1.0.0 packages for Everything, Filesystem, Memory and Sequential Thinking, plus dated Python packages for Fetch, Git and Time.
selected.availability: Published on npm or PyPI. The repository says these are educational reference implementations, not production-ready solutions.
selected.practical_use: Pin and inspect the Filesystem or Memory reference server to learn the MCP tool contract, then add safeguards before adapting it to a real agent.

editorial_review.context: repositories / builder / daily; MCP reference servers v1.0.0; event date 2026-10-11
editorial_review.viewer_question: What changed in the MCP reference servers v1.0.0 release, and how should a builder evaluate one without treating it as production-ready?
editorial_review.prerequisites: An MCP-compatible client, Node.js for TypeScript packages or Python with uvx/pip for Python packages, and a disposable local test directory.
editorial_review.central_task: Pin one reference package, configure the narrowest local scope, inspect its tool contract and treat it as a learning baseline before production hardening.
editorial_review.new_capability: The steering-group repository now publishes four TypeScript reference servers at semantic version 1.0.0 and three Python references under a dated release, with a release audit and package-specific fixes.
editorial_review.closest_archive_coverage: All episode files and confirmed receipts checked. 2026-09-28-codex-mcp-oauth covered client authentication, not reference-server packaging or evaluation.
editorial_review.supported_payoff: Builders can choose the correct package and first command, inspect a concrete MCP reference implementation and avoid promoting an educational server directly into production.
editorial_review.evidence_mode_reason: Documented walkthrough based on the signed GitHub release and repository README; no live package execution or security assessment.
editorial_review.alternatives: OpenAI and Google updates were already covered or are migration notices; Anthropic's latest model launch is covered; KPA remains research-only.
editorial_review.selection_rationale: A verified October 11 release with installable artifacts, reproducible starting commands and a material production caveat.
editorial_review.search_query: MCP reference servers v1.0.0 filesystem memory setup
editorial_review.final_verdict: approved after source review: the script teaches package choice, a scoped first evaluation and the production-hardening boundary while clearly labeling the lack of a live test.
editorial_review.metadata_review: Completed title, script and description reviewed: the exact repository/version and evaluation task lead; no production-readiness, live-test or security-audit claim is implied.

playlist_review.reason: The complete video evaluates one official repository release for builders: package versions, prerequisites, first commands, scoped inspection and the explicit reference-only production boundary. Every section serves the repositories playlist.
